title: Normalized inventory item definition (legacy inventory_items domain)
description: Contract for one normalized inventory item: one stored legacy inventory_items object entry. The stored object key is the stable identity, so legacy_id is the key verbatim (rule N2); string-encoded numerics coerce to integers (rule N1) and display strings are kept verbatim. See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored inventory_items object key preserved verbatim (rule N2): the decimal inventory id string.

kind.description: Classification of the stored inventory_items domain: every entry maps to inventory_item.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets inventory_items).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets inventory_items).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Inventory id coerced from the string-encoded stored value to an integer (rule N1).

name.description: Inventory display name, preserved verbatim (rule N1).

cashPrice.description: Cash price coerced from the string-encoded stored value to an integer (rule N1).

droppable.description: Droppable flag coerced from the string-encoded stored value to an integer (rule N1).

dropRate.description: Drop rate coerced from the string-encoded stored value to an integer (rule N1).

dropsFrom.description: Drop-source code coerced from the string-encoded stored value to an integer; carried as an opaque code, never treated as an item reference (rule N1).

description.description: Inventory display description, preserved verbatim (rule N1).
